lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: Welcome to the Data Desk! I'm Laras, a senior data analyst. Just call me Laras.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: Here you write real SQL. Type a query, press Run Query, then compare your result with the requested one.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: Your query is also quietly checked on other data, so no memorising answers.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: There are also charts from colleagues: APPROVE if honest, REVISE if misleading, ESCALATE if it needs a manager.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: First shift done! You've used SELECT, WHERE and ORDER BY, and caught a chart that exaggerated.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: Remember: correct numbers shown in a misleading way can still fool people.
